articles.title_en: Self-Enforcing Environmental Agreements with the Optimal Intensity of Cooperation
articles.title_cn: 最优合作强度下的自我执行环境协议
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes international environmental agreements in three-stage games consisting of a membership subgame, the signatories’ decision on the intensity of cooperation, and an emissions subgame. Signatories may act as Stackelberg leaders or play Nash. In the Stackelberg game, the highest intensity of cooperation between signatories is optimal. In the Nash game, a moderate or the highest intensity of cooperation is optimal if emissions are strategic substitutes. In this case the equilibrium emissions and the stable coalition of the Nash game with optimal cooperation intensity are identical to the equilibrium emissions and the stable coalition of the Stackelberg game with the highest cooperation intensity. Finally, we apply our results to coalition formation games of the literature. In the applied Nash games, optimizing with respect to the cooperation intensity may enlarge the stable coalition up to the grand coalition which implements the first best.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了由成员资格子博弈、签署国关于合作强度的决策以及排放子博弈组成的三阶段博弈中的国际环境协议。签署国可能作为斯塔克伯格领导者行动或进行纳什博弈。在斯塔克伯格博弈中，签署国之间的最高合作强度是最优的。在纳什博弈中，如果排放是战略替代品，则中等或最高的合作强度是最优的。在这种情况下，具有最优合作强度的纳什博弈的均衡排放和稳定联盟与具有最高合作强度的斯塔克伯格博弈的均衡排放和稳定联盟相同。最后，我们将我们的结果应用于文献中的联盟形成博弈。在应用的纳什博弈中，相对于合作强度进行优化可能会将稳定联盟扩大至实施最优的大联盟。

articles.title_en: Thirsty for Trade: How Globalization Shapes Virtual Water Trade
articles.title_cn: 渴望贸易：全球化如何塑造虚拟水贸易
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the distributional implications of trade policy (import tariffs) for virtual water embodied in traded agricultural products. To do this, we undertake an econometric analysis and counterfactual simulation exercise using a structural gravity framework to quantify the impacts of (i) preferential tariff schemes and (ii) hypothetical global tariff liberalization for virtual water trade in 15 major primary agricultural commodities. We find that tariff preferences have been responsible for increased virtual water exports from developing water-scarce countries predominantly located in Africa and Asia. Conversely, tariff preferences are responsible for higher levels of virtual water imports by countries in the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. However, we estimate that further trade liberalization would reverse this pattern and benefit many water-scarce countries in the Global South in securing their domestic water resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了贸易政策（进口关税）对贸易农产品中隐含的虚拟水的分配影响。为此，我们采用结构引力框架进行了计量经济分析和反事实模拟，以量化（i）优惠关税方案和（ii）假设的全球关税自由化对15种主要初级农产品虚拟水贸易的影响。我们发现，关税优惠促进了主要位于非洲和亚洲的发展中缺水国家的虚拟水出口增加。相反，关税优惠导致美洲、欧洲和中东国家的虚拟水进口水平提高。然而，我们估计，进一步的贸易自由化将逆转这一模式，并使全球南方的许多缺水国家在保障其国内水资源方面受益。

articles.title_en: The ‘Climate Adaptation Problem’ in Biodiversity Conservation: The Value of Spatial Flexibility in Land Purchase
articles.title_cn: 生物多样性保护中的“气候适应问题”：土地购买中空间灵活性的价值
authors: Charlotte Gerling (Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg)
Oliver Schöttker (Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg)
articles.abstract_en: Existing reserve networks become less suitable as species’ ranges shift under climate change and the scarcity and value of habitats change. Reserve sites hence have to be reallocated to reflect these changing values and to remain cost-effective, but restrictions on selling reserve sites limit this adaptation. Under climate change, a novel ‘sale’ policy that provides resale flexibility by allowing increasingly less cost-effective sites to be sold to free funds for purchasing increasingly cost-effective sites may hence be preferable over a typical ‘no sale’ policy. Here, we develop a conceptual climate-ecological-economic model to examine under what conditions resale flexibility provides cost-effectiveness advantages. We find that the benefits of resale flexibility provided by the ’sale’ policy are particularly high when little funding is available for climate change adaptation. Due to this budget effect, the value of resale flexibility also decreases with increasing interest rates. The value of resale flexibility is particularly high when creating reserves for species that are highly mobile as new reserve sites may then be chosen freely (in comparison to the case that new sites have to be located in the proximity of existing reserve sites). We further examine to what extent the ‘sale’ policy reduces the permanence of habitat within a specific location (“site habitat permanence”), and identify a new trade-off: ’sale’ provides advantages for habitat types that become increasingly rare, while ’no sale’ improves site habitat permanence mainly for expanding habitat types.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化下物种分布范围的变化以及栖息地稀缺性和价值的改变，现有的保护区网络变得不再适用。因此，保护区地点需要重新分配以反映这些变化的价值并保持成本效益，但对出售保护区地点的限制限制了这种适应。在气候变化下，一种新颖的“出售”政策，通过允许出售越来越不具成本效益的地点以释放资金用于购买越来越具成本效益的地点，从而提供转售灵活性，可能比典型的“不出售”政策更可取。在此，我们开发了一个概念性的气候-生态-经济模型，以检验在何种条件下转售灵活性提供成本效益优势。我们发现，“出售”政策提供的转售灵活性的好处在可用于气候适应资金很少时尤其高。由于这种预算效应，转售灵活性的价值也随着利率的上升而降低。当为高度移动的物种建立保护区时，转售灵活性的价值尤其高，因为新的保护区地点可以自由选择（与必须位于现有保护区附近的情况相比）。我们进一步检验了“出售”政策在多大程度上降低了特定地点内栖息地的持久性（“地点栖息地持久性”），并识别出一个新的权衡：“出售”对变得越来越稀有的栖息地类型有利，而“不出售”主要改善扩张栖息地类型的地点栖息地持久性。

articles.title_en: Willingness to Pay for Nature Protection: Crowdfunding as a Payment Mechanism
articles.title_cn: 自然保护的支付意愿：众筹作为支付机制
authors: Maria A. Cunha-e-Sá (Universidade Nova de Lisboa)
Luis Catela Nunes (Universidade Nova de Lisboa)
Margarida Ortigão (Universidade Nova de Lisboa Universidade de Lisboa)
Renato Rosa (Universidade Nova de Lisboa Faculty of Economics, Universidade de Coimbra)
Carina Vieira-da-Silva (Faculdade de Direito da Universidade de Lisboa)
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we use a discrete choice experiment to elicit the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for preventing and mitigating the effects of oil spills on marine and coastal ecosystem services, along a particularly vulnerable coastal region of mainland Portugal. We used a split-sample design to analyze the differences between two payment vehicles (PV): a mandatory extra income tax and a voluntary contribution collected by a crowdfunding campaign with a provision point mechanism and a money-back guarantee. The difference between the two PVs is examined in a setting where the local population has a negative perception of the quality of institutions. We find that respondents are more willing to contribute when presented with the crowdfunding version. Also, regardless of the payment vehicle, respondents who express a mistrust in institutions are more likely to choose the status quo. These results suggest the potential of using crowdfunding to support ecosystem services’ conservation initiatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们采用离散选择实验来引出对防止和减轻石油泄漏对海洋和沿海生态系统服务影响的支付意愿（WTP），研究区域位于葡萄牙大陆一个特别脆弱的沿海地区。我们使用了分裂样本设计来分析两种支付工具（PV）之间的差异：强制性附加所得税和通过众筹活动收集的自愿捐款，该众筹活动设有提供点机制和退款保证。在地方居民对机构质量持负面看法的背景下，考察了两种支付工具之间的差异。我们发现，当呈现众筹版本时，受访者更愿意贡献。此外，无论支付工具如何，对机构表示不信任的受访者更可能选择现状。这些结果表明，利用众筹支持生态系统服务保护倡议具有潜力。

articles.title_en: Transaction Costs, Participation, and the Cost-Effectiveness of Reverse Auctions: Evidence from a Laboratory Experiment
articles.title_cn: 交易成本、参与及反向拍卖的成本效益：来自实验室实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Reverse auctions are often recognized as a tool that can cost-effectively allocate agri-environmental program funds to support environmentally-beneficial land management practices. However, transaction costs can limit participation in auctions which limits their cost-effectiveness. We use a laboratory experiment to examine how various levels of transaction costs influence participation and bidding behavior in discriminatory-price reverse auctions in low and high budget scenarios. Our experimental results show that transaction costs limit auction participation, increase bid amounts, and reduce cost-effectiveness. The negative effect of transaction costs on participation is particularly large when the budget level is low. Using the results of our experiment, we design a simulation to investigate whether reducing transaction costs via subsidies could increase program cost-effectiveness under various conditions. We find that transaction cost subsidies increase auction cost-effectiveness; however, our study raises new questions about how these subsidies are designed and the implications for the overall costs and benefits of efforts to reduce transaction costs in reverse auctions.
articles.abstract_cn: 反向拍卖常被视为一种能够以成本效益方式分配农业环境项目资金，以支持有益于环境的土地管理实践的工具。然而，交易成本可能限制拍卖参与，从而限制其成本效益。我们使用实验室实验来考察不同水平的交易成本如何影响低价和高预算情景下歧视性价格反向拍卖中的参与和投标行为。我们的实验结果表明，交易成本限制了拍卖参与，增加了投标金额，并降低了成本效益。当预算水平较低时，交易成本对参与的负面影响尤为显著。利用我们的实验结果，我们设计了一个模拟，以调查在各种条件下，通过补贴减少交易成本是否能提高项目的成本效益。我们发现，交易成本补贴提高了拍卖的成本效益；然而，我们的研究提出了关于这些补贴如何设计的新问题，以及其对减少反向拍卖中交易成本努力的总体成本和收益的影响。

articles.title_en: The Amenity Value of Bicycle Infrastructure: A Hedonic Application to Greater Manchester, UK
articles.title_cn: 自行车基础设施的舒适性价值：对英国大曼彻斯特的享乐主义应用
articles.abstract_en: Using hedonic and spatial regressions, this paper estimates a significantly larger association between proximity to bicycle networks and property prices than previously reported. As cities face increasing challenges of congestion and pollution, many are implementing policies to integrate bicycle facilities and other active modes of transport. However, policymakers are slow to support these initiatives and remain skeptical due to the investment costs required and appropriation of limited land. Drawing on a large dataset of approximately 253,000 transactions in Greater Manchester, over a 9-year period, we find clear evidenced that a 1 km reduction in distance to the nearest bicycle network is associated with property values being around 2.8% higher, on average, and 7.7% higher in the central borough of Manchester. We also provide an applied example to rank new bicycle routes by comparing their benefit-to-cost ratios and a discussion on the property tax system.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用享乐回归和空间回归，本文估计了自行车网络邻近性与房产价格之间的关联，其显著大于先前报告的结果。随着城市面临日益严重的拥堵和污染挑战，许多城市正在实施政策以整合自行车设施和其他主动交通方式。然而，政策制定者对这些举措的支持缓慢，并且由于所需的投资成本和有限土地的占用而持怀疑态度。基于大曼彻斯特约253,000笔交易的大型数据集，跨越9年时间，我们发现明确证据表明，距离最近自行车网络的距离每减少1公里，房产价值平均高出约2.8%，在曼彻斯特中心城区则高出7.7%。我们还提供了一个应用实例，通过比较效益成本比来对新自行车路线进行排序，并讨论了房产税制度。

articles.title_en: Agentizing a General Equilibrium Model of Environmental Tax Reform
articles.title_cn: 环境税改革的一般均衡模型的代理化
authors: Franziska Klein (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona Mercator Research Institute on Global Commons and Climate Change Wageningen University)
Jeroen van den Bergh (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona VU University Amsterdam VU University Amsterdam ICREA)
Joël Foramitti (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona VU University Amsterdam)
Théo Konc (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona Technical University of Berlin Potsdam Institute for Climate Research Impact Wageningen University and Research)
articles.abstract_en: Environmental tax reform (ETR), a shift from labour to carbon taxes, has been mostly modelled using general equilibrium (GE) analysis. Since a low-carbon transition will require deep transformations, one will also have to address out-of-equilibrium dynamics and increased agent heterogeneity. Unlike GE models, agent-based models (ABMs) are well equipped to deal with this. We therefore replicate a recent GE model for ETR using an agent-based approach. This process, known as "agentization", allows assessing similarities as well as differences in policy impacts between the two modelling approaches, in turn providing a test of the robustness of the GE results. We find that the agent-based model is able to replicate many results of the general equilibrium analysis, while revealing strengths and weaknesses of both model types. We discuss concrete implementation steps and difficulties experienced in the GE-ABM translation process. We illustrate the potential of ABM by extending the model in several directions. We show that heterogeneous subsistence consumption can increase the space for combining a double dividend with an equity goal, and that overall macro-economic results can conceal important distributional impacts when green preferences and labour supply elasticities vary.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境税改革（ETR），即从劳动税转向碳税，大多采用一般均衡（GE）分析进行建模。由于低碳转型需要深度变革，还必须解决非均衡动态和日益增长的代理异质性。与GE模型不同，基于代理的模型（ABMs）能够很好地处理这些问题。因此，我们采用基于代理的方法复制了一个近期的ETR一般均衡模型。这一过程称为“代理化”，允许评估两种建模方法在政策影响上的相似性和差异性，进而检验GE结果的稳健性。我们发现，基于代理的模型能够复制一般均衡分析的许多结果，同时揭示两种模型类型的优缺点。我们讨论了在GE-ABM转换过程中遇到的具体实施步骤和困难。我们通过多个方向扩展模型来展示ABM的潜力。我们表明，异质性生存消费可以扩大实现双重红利与公平目标相结合的空间，并且当绿色偏好和劳动供给弹性变化时，总体宏观经济结果可能掩盖重要的分配影响。

articles.title_en: Understanding Automation’s Impact on Ecological Footprint: Theory and Empirical Evidence from Europe
articles.title_cn: 理解自动化对生态足迹的影响：来自欧洲的理论与实证证据
articles.abstract_en: As technological advancements continue to unfold, automation has emerged as a pivotal force in reshaping both production paradigms and lifestyles. This paper introduces a comprehensive general equilibrium framework that encapsulates both automation and ecological environment. Through comparative static analysis, it seeks to elucidate the influence of automation on the environment. Furthermore, employing 32 European nations from 2000 to 2019 as samples, this research empirically investigates the propositions using panel least squares regression alongside panel threshold regression methods. In addition, this study employs predictions generated by an LSTM model using data from 1993 to 1999 as instrumental variables to address endogeneity. The findings reveal two opposing impacts of automation on the environment: the Leisure Effect, which worsens ecological degradation, and the Conservation Effect, which improves environmental quality. When environmental awareness is high, the Conservation Effect dominates, significantly reducing the ecological footprint. Moreover, as automation technology level advances, its capacity to curtail the ecological footprint intensifies. Specifically, from the perspective of the full sample, the addition of one robot per thousand workers leads to a 0.13 unit reduction in the natural logarithm of ecological footprint; meanwhile, the suppressive effect varies by approximately 3 to 10 times before and after reaching certain thresholds of environmental awareness and technological advancement behind automation. Subsequent grouped regression analysis further elucidates that within European contexts, automation’s footprint-reducing effects are predominantly observed in nations with GDP per capita below $20,000, advanced digitalization, lower environmental dependence, reduced military spending, and strong government intervention.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着技术进步的不断推进，自动化已成为重塑生产模式和生活方式的关键力量。本文引入了一个包含自动化和生态环境的综合一般均衡框架。通过比较静态分析，旨在阐明自动化对环境的影响。此外，以2000年至2019年间32个欧洲国家为样本，本研究采用面板最小二乘回归和面板门槛回归方法实证检验了相关命题。同时，本研究利用1993年至1999年数据生成的LSTM模型预测作为工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果揭示了自动化对环境的两方面相反影响：休闲效应加剧了生态退化，而保护效应则改善了环境质量。当环保意识较高时，保护效应占主导地位，显著减少了生态足迹。此外，随着自动化技术水平的提升，其削减生态足迹的能力也在增强。具体而言，从全样本角度来看，每千名工人增加一台机器人会导致生态足迹自然对数减少0.13个单位；同时，在达到环保意识和自动化背后技术进步的某些门槛前后，抑制效应大约相差3至10倍。随后的分组回归分析进一步阐明，在欧洲背景下，自动化的足迹削减效应主要出现在人均GDP低于20,000美元、数字化程度高、环境依赖性低、军费开支少以及政府干预强的国家中。

articles.title_en: Behavioural Drivers of Cooking Energy Choice in Benin
articles.title_cn: 贝宁烹饪能源选择的行为驱动因素
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the behavioural drivers of households’ cooking energy decision-making. We empirically examine the effect of time and spatial discounting on cooking energy choices using Generalised Structural Equation Modelling. We rely on the nationally representative household dataset from Benin’s Harmonised Survey on Living Conditions of Households in 2019. The findings highlight that households’ tendencies towards temporal discounting have detrimental effects on cleaner cooking energies, while spatial discounting promotes the adoption of cleaner cooking energy sources. Furthermore, we discern that the influence of time and spatial discounting varies across rural and urban areas, yielding heterogeneous effects. These findings have implications for a better understanding of the non-economic constraints that hinder the promotion of cleaner cooking energies in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了家庭烹饪能源决策的行为驱动因素。我们使用广义结构方程模型，实证检验了时间和空间贴现对烹饪能源选择的影响。我们依赖于贝宁2019年家庭生活条件协调调查的全国代表性家庭数据集。研究结果表明，家庭对时间贴现的倾向对更清洁的烹饪能源有不利影响，而空间贴现则促进了更清洁烹饪能源的采用。此外，我们发现时间和空间贴现的影响在城乡地区有所不同，产生了异质性效应。这些发现对于更好地理解阻碍发展中国家推广更清洁烹饪能源的非经济约束具有启示意义。
